name: Platypus pool cash/liability accounting manipulation
summary: A partial withdrawal reduced the full LP liability despite insufficient cash, allowing repeated coverage-ratio and slippage manipulation across deposits, withdrawals, and swaps.
notes: The third and final pre-incident Upgraded event selected the vulnerable Platypus pool implementation.
CertiK reports $2.23 million of WAVAX and sAVAX taken across the three related flash-loan transactions by two attacker EOAs; the figure is the aggregate gross incident loss before recovery.
The reported aggregate does not publish exact token quantities for all three exploit transactions.
